name: Aer Lingus Visa Signature Card

apr.notes: 19.24% to 27.74% variable APR. APR is Min of (Prime + 12.49%) and 29.99% to Min of (Prime + 20.99%) and 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on card purchases.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 Avios for every $1 spent on all other purchases.

categories.label: Flight purchases made directly with Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia and LEVEL
Hotel accommodations booked directly with the hotel

rewards.redemption_notes: Avios can be redeemed through Aer Lingus, British Airways, and Iberia loyalty programs.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 75,000 Avios after you spend $5,000 on purchases within the first 3 months of account opening.

benefits.title: Economy Companion Ticket
benefits.description: Every calendar year you make purchases of $30,000 on your Aer Lingus Visa Signature Card, you'll receive an economy companion ticket good for 12 months.

benefits.title: Priority Boarding
benefits.description: You and any authorized users on your account are eligible for Priority Boarding on Aer Lingus flights departing from and returning to the US from Ireland, subject to availability.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on card purchases.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Get one-year complimentary DashPass, membership for both DoorDash and Caviar, that provides unlimited deliveries with $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible orders. Activate by Dec 31, 2027.

other: Economy Companion Ticket after $30,000 spend per calendar year
Priority Boarding on Aer Lingus flights
